statement: A bare major type 7 break stop code (additional-info 31) on its own is not decoded
deviation: `ff` is the break stop code that closes an indefinite-length item, and does not appear where no indefinite-length item is open. Since 42 §2.1-3 forbids indefinite length, gx has no way to open one, and therefore no way to close one. P-3 (`7f6161ff`) walks ai 31 via the indefinite text-string / head path, but this vector walks ai 31 via the major-type-7 path -- discriminating that the same additional-info is judged by a different arm of a different function.
